draft_en.subject: An active line next to BlueOptics transceivers - industrial switch or converter SKU on the roadmap?
draft_en.body:
Hi Sandra,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "Marvell Industrial Alert System" on 22 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Transceivers, DAC and AOC are BlueOptics and we do not carry them. To complement the range with an active line under the BlueOptics label from small lots, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP unmanaged - model STI-280GE - $46 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2 managed, Marvell-based - STI-288GPM - $85.5; Gigabit media converter, 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP slot - STI-110GE - $26.5. Your optics plug in as they are.

One question: is an industrial switch or converter SKU on the BlueOptics roadmap for 2027, or does the shop stay passive-only?

Best regards,
Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
